summary: Iteration 6 (Web Admin Dashboard — full CRUD + gate + mobile-vs-admin separation). Backend 72/72 pytest pass (added TestAdminDashboardCategories with 7 new tests). Verified: (a) POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/categories and /api/admin/product_categories persist and GET /api/categories + GET /api/marketplace/categories reflect create/update/delete round-trips. (b) Non-admin visitor gets 403 on all admin/categories + admin/product_categories + admin/stats endpoints. (c) /api/admin/stats returns all 10 counts (users, destinations, trips, products, experiences, bookings, offers, events, services, orders). (d) POST /api/admin/destinations with images[] array + cover_image + latitude/longitude persists exactly and appears in GET /api/destinations (list + detail); edit and delete round-trip. Frontend web-desktop (1280x860): (1) /admin without auth shows AdminLogin gate (admin-login-email/password/submit). (2) Logging in as visitor@socotra.app → Access Denied screen with denied-logout (NOT the dashboard). (3) Logging in as admin@socotra.app → dashboard with 10 live stat cards (stat-destinations=12, trips=3, experiences=7, products=8, offers=2, events=3, services=4, bookings=28, orders=8, users=10) and sidebar with all 11 nav testIDs (nav-home, nav-places, nav-trips, nav-experiences, nav-products, nav-offers, nav-events, nav-services, nav-categories, nav-product-categories, nav-bookings). (4) /admin/places shows the 12 seeded destinations with thumbnails; entity-add opened the modal form and I created a new place (name_ar/name_en, category=nature via field-category → opt-nature, location_ar, image via image-url-input+add-image-url, lat=12.5 / lng=54, marker_icon=leaf); after entity-save the row appeared in the list AND was persisted in GET /api/destinations with images:['https://example.com/test.jpg'], cover_image auto-set to images[0], latitude=12.5, longitude=54, marker_icon='leaf'. (5) edit-<id> opened the edit form, changed name_en→'TEST Edited Name', entity-save persisted (verified via GET /api/destinations/<id>). (6) delete-<id> removed it (verified missing in GET /api/destinations). (7) /admin/categories entity-add: created new category (key=test_playwright_cat, name_ar/en, icon-leaf, color, order=999) — verified visible in GET /api/categories AND selectable as opt-test_playwright_cat in the places form field-category. (8) Mobile viewport 390x844: top bar (admin-logout) + horizontally scrollable nav (nav-places visible) both render correctly. No red-screens, no admin_login flow errors. Pre-existing non-blocking RN-Web warnings (shadow* / props.pointerEvents) unchanged from iteration 5.

issues: Pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking, same as iteration 5. Anonymous /api/auth/me 401 fires once before login (expected — no token yet).

action_items: None blocking. Web Admin Dashboard is fully functional end-to-end (secure gate, non-admin denial, sidebar+stats, full CRUD for places, edit, delete, categories CRUD reflected in place-form select, mobile-narrow layout).
Optional (nice-to-have): add a confirmation dialog for delete-<id> — currently one tap deletes silently. Not a bug per spec, just UX polish.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: adding 'categories'→db.destination_categories and 'product_categories'→db.product_categories to _ADMIN_COLLS cleanly reuses the generic /api/admin/{entity} CRUD; no schema changes needed. Public GET /api/categories and /api/marketplace/categories both exclude _id, so no ObjectId leaks.
Backend: /api/admin/stats now returns 10 counts including offers/events/services/orders — matches the stat cards on the dashboard.
Frontend: AdminShell has clean three-way branching (loading → login → access denied → dashboard) tied to useAuth().user + user.is_admin. Non-admin users cannot see the sidebar/nav at all.

Frontend: EntityScreen consistently emits testIDs entity-add / entity-search / entity-save / row-<id> / edit-<id> / delete-<id> / field-<k> / opt-<value> / icon-<name>, and MultiImageField emits image-url-input / add-image-url / image-<i> / make-cover-<i> / del-image-<i>. This is what enabled the full playwright walkthrough.

Frontend: Save path in EntityScreen (via MultiImageField) auto-syncs cover_image=images[0], confirmed by backend response showing cover_image mirrored to the first image when only 'images' was provided in the form.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (added TestAdminDashboardCategories with 7 tests: admin_stats keys, stats non-admin 403, categories CRUD + public reflect, categories non-admin 403, product_categories CRUD + public reflect, product_categories non-admin 403, destination with images[]+coords public reflect)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 8 requested flows verified — /admin login gate, non-admin access-denied, admin dashboard with 10 stat cards + 11 sidebar nav testIDs, /admin/places create with all fields + images URL + lat/lng, backend persistence via GET /api/destinations, edit-<id> persistence, delete-<id> removal, categories CRUD reflected in places form select, mobile 390x844 layout

seed_data_creation: None permanent. Playwright test created one destination and one category via UI; the destination was deleted through the UI delete-<id> button and the category was deleted via curl to /api/admin/categories after the run to leave the DB clean. Pytest suite uses TEST_-prefixed data and cleans in finally blocks.
